title: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB — Transport & Parking
claims: Athlete shuttle buses run from Village Green on Tutanekai St: TMiler 3:00-3:30am for NZ$10, T102 5:00-5:30am for NZ$20, T50 5:45-6:30am for NZ$10, T21 8:30-9:15am for NZ$10, and T14 from the Novotel front entrance 6:30-7:00am for NZ$10.
A spectator shuttle to the Puarenga aid station leaves the Waipa MTB Carpark in a constant loop from 7:15am to 10:30am, takes 5 minutes one way and costs NZ$8 return.

A spectator shuttle to the Okataina aid station leaves the Rotoiti Rugby Club every 30 minutes from 9:30am Saturday to 5:00am Sunday, with the final bus departing Okataina at 6:00am, taking 20 minutes one way and costing NZ$20 return.
Lake Okataina Road is closed to event traffic for the duration of the event and spectators are told not to drive directly to the aid station.
Limited free parking is available at all start lines, there is no dedicated event parking at the Village Green, and not all aid stations are accessible by car.
Bus tickets can be purchased via the registration account.
